Last Friday, Leo and Nina went to the plant garden. The weather was cloudy that day. Nina is interested in cooking. In fact, wild flowers covered the hillside.
Leo and Nina had great fun there. Leo learned a lot about music. Leo is going to travel to Rome in February. Some mushrooms contain poison.
Leo plays table tennis with Nina every Friday. Life is full of small surprises. Nina's birthday is in February. The lake shone in the moonlight.
Both of them like rice and milk. Leo thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. They took many photos at the flower market.
